_trigger: after adding/removing scheduler file, update count + list

jobs.name: eveningSummary
jobs.desc: Evening market summary (rescheduled task 1186 — avoids race with intelligenceCycleJob at 22:00)

jobs.name: cronHealthAlert
jobs.desc: Alert WORK channel when any job success_rate < 80%

jobs.name: calibrationReportJob
jobs.desc: Weekly Brier score calibration report + Telegram digest

jobs.name: foreignFlowAlertJob
jobs.desc: Daily foreign flow smart-money scan — HIGH alerts + evidence fragments

jobs.name: insiderCheckJob
jobs.desc: Daily SSC insider transaction check + streak detection + evidence fragments

jobs.name: baseRateComputation
jobs.desc: Weekly Bayesian base-rate recompute from evidence_fragments (baseRateComputationJob.ts)

jobs.name: predictionResolution
jobs.desc: Daily prediction claim auto-resolution after market close (predictionResolutionJob.ts)

jobs.name: pipelineWatchdog
jobs.desc: Stale news pipeline detection — alerts work channel when staleMins > 90, 3h cooldown

jobs.name: franceSummaryJob
jobs.desc: France morning VN digest to MARKET channel: top 3 price movers, top 3 alerts, TA signal count — Vietnamese format, silent skip when empty. alreadySentToday dedup prevents multi-fire within same UTC day.

jobs.name: taAlertScanJob
jobs.desc: RSI(14) overbought/oversold intraday scan — inserts ta_overbought/ta_oversold alerts, 4h cooldown

jobs.name: bbAlertScanJob
jobs.desc: BB20 upper/lower breakout intraday scan — inserts ta_bb_breakout_up/ta_bb_breakout_down alerts, 4h cooldown

jobs.name: taAlertNotifierJob
jobs.desc: Deliver unnotified TA alerts (ta_overbought/ta_oversold/ta_bb_breakout_up/down) to Telegram market channel — batch 10/cycle

jobs.name: ohlcvDailyAggregatorJob
jobs.desc: Aggregate intraday market_prices_history ticks into daily_ohlcv rows post-market-close. Sends WORK-channel summary: rows per ticker, TA-ready count, top-3 tickers. (Sprint 122+127)

jobs.name: ohlcvStartupProbe
jobs.desc: On server start: detect sparse daily_ohlcv tickers (<8 rows), write pending record to ohlcv_backfill_queue, alert WORK channel. VPS polls queue every 30min and runs backfill. (Sprint 119+123)

jobs.name: ohlcvStalenessCheckJob
jobs.desc: OHLCV staleness check weekdays — alerts WORK channel when daily_ohlcv rows are stale or missing post-market-close

jobs.name: cascadeBacktestJob
jobs.desc: Daily backtest: fills price_impact_3d/7d/outcome_correct on cascade_rule_hits rows older than 3 days using daily_ohlcv closes. Sends WORK summary.

jobs.name: walCheckpointAlert
jobs.desc: WAL stuck Telegram alert helper — sends WORK channel alert when WAL checkpoint is stale (Sprint 179)
